$comment: Official sources per country, read by harvest.py. A host is official when it is, or is a subdomain of, a listed domain, or matches a pattern. Official pages are re-checked weekly and reported by `harvest.py changes`; their domains are allowlisted by `harvest.py sync`. `watch` pages are harvested even when no profile cites them yet. `access` records what the harvest saw, with the date. See docs/HARVEST.md.

europa.eu.what: EU institutions (Parliament, Commission, Council, Court of Justice)

admin.ch.what: Federal administration (Federal Council, departments, Federal Chancellery)

bundestag.de.what: Bundestag, including members' declared side income

hatvp.fr.what: High Authority for Transparency in Public Life (asset and interest declarations)

parlament.hu.what: National Assembly, including members' asset declarations

governo.it.what: Presidency of the Council of Ministers

gov.sk.what: Public administration: Government Office (vlada.gov.sk), Prosecutor General (genpro.gov.sk), Supreme Audit Office (nku.gov.sk), Ministry of Justice, register of public-sector partners (rpvs.gov.sk), contracts register (crz.gov.sk)
gov.sk.access: 2026-10-21: vlada.gov.sk and crz.gov.sk reset connections from outside Slovakia (waf-redirect.gov.sk), so they are unreachable; the other subdomains render

nrsr.sk.what: National Council (parliament): members, votes, and the asset declarations of public officials (members of parliament and of the government), published by its Committee on Incompatibility of Functions
nrsr.sk.access: 2026-10-21: every page answers with a BunkerWeb proof-of-work bot check (status blocked); check by hand

prezident.sk.what: President: appointments and dismissals (prime minister, ministers, judges), laws signed or returned

slov-lex.sk.what: Collection of Laws (legislation and its official versions)
slov-lex.sk.access: 2026-10-21: pages build their text with scripts; the harvest gets the title only (status error)

nssud.sk.access: 2026-10-21: answers with a web-firewall block page (status blocked)

minv.sk.what: Ministry of the Interior: State Commission for Elections and Control of Financing of Political Parties, party annual reports, Government Gazette

statistics.sk.what: Statistical Office: official election and referendum results (volby.statistics.sk)

volbysr.sk.what: Statistical Office: results site for the 2026 elections

watch.what: Appointments and dismissals by the President: government reshuffles
Laws signed by the President or returned to parliament
Annual reports of political parties and movements
Meetings of the State Commission for Elections and Control of Financing of Political Parties
